subject: MAP draft — milestones, owners & target signing sprint
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>
To: Tom Harris <tom.harris@clearlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft — milestones, owners & target signing sprint

Tom — thanks for the time today. Per our discovery, you asked for a concrete Mutual Action Plan (MAP) we can take to procurement/legal so everyone has a shared timeline to hit the Q4 integration window. I attached a first-pass MAP and a lightweight SOW draft for context (see attachments).

Key asks from our side:
- Confirm primary signatory and legal contact at Clearline for contract turnaround.
- Confirm procurement signature target date — you mentioned "end of September" on the call; can you confirm a hard date so we can align provisioning?
- Identify any long-lead dependencies (IT security review, enclave/network setup, vendor risk review).

What's in the attached MAP (high-level):
1) Milestone: Legal review complete — owner: Clearline legal (Aisha?) — target: 2027-09-20
2) Milestone: Procurement approval & PO — owner: Clearline procurement — target: 2027-09-25
3) Milestone: Contract signature (DocuSign) — owner: Clearline signatory — target: 2027-09-30
4) Milestone: Dedicated capacity provisioning & onboarding — owner: Redwood ops/Marcus — target: 2027-10-07

If Clearline can confirm signatory and confirm whether 2027-09-30 is feasible, we'll lock the MAP and surface a canary provisioning plan so Marcus can begin pre-provision activities (network checklist, IP allowlist, keying).

Attachments: Clearline_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet) | SOW_draft_Clearline.pdf (PDF)

Thanks —
Priya
Priya Natarajan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priya.n@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

---
Redwood Inference — developer-first inference for production-grade LLMs

From: Tom Harris <tom.harris@clearlinehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.n@redwood.com>
Cc: Aisha Rao <aisha.rao@clearlinehealth.com>, procure@clearlinehealth.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 09 Sep 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP draft — milestones, owners & target signing sprint

Priya — appreciate the quick follow-up and the MAP. A few notes from procurement/legal side after a quick skim: 

1) Legal contact: Aisha Rao will lead the review. She asked that you also include a short data flow diagram and a SOC2 scoping note in the next pass. She needs those to validate the SLA/controls in the SOW.
2) Procurement: our central procurement mailbox (procure@clearlinehealth.com) owns PO timing. They need the final SOW + pricing table to lock budget.
3) Signature target: end of September sounds right to internal stakeholders, but there is a scheduled vendor review on 2027-09-22 that could be a gating event. If legal and procurement can sign off at that review, we can route to our signatory the same week. Realistically, I think 2027-09-29 is a more conservative signature target unless legal returns with redlines earlier.

Can you: 
- Add a short appendix (1 page) detailing data residency and retention options?
- Confirm whether Redwood can accept a limited data processing addendum (we typically include one).

I'll check with procurement for a hard PO date and loop back. If Redwood can provide the updated MAP and the DPA note by 2027-09-14 EOD, I will prioritize the vendor review slot on 2027-09-22.

Thanks —
Tom
Tom Harris
VP, Product & Operations | Clearline Health
Tom.Harris@clearlinehealth.com

Subject: Re: MAP draft — milestones, owners & target signing sprint

Aisha/Tom/Procurement — thanks for the clear asks. Attached is MAP_v1.1 (small updates) and a one-page appendix called "Data & Security Snapshot" that summarizes residency, retention, and our SOC 2 posture. Highlights:
- Data residency: options for US-only processing; customer-managed VPC for private deployment available under Redwood Private.
- Retention: default 30 days for KV + logs; extended retention options in the SOW.
- Controls: SOC2 Type II report available; we can gate a redacted copy to legal under NDA.

Updated milestone table (excerpt):
- Legal review complete — owner: Clearline legal (Aisha) — target: 2027-09-18 (requested earlier to hit the vendor review)
- Vendor review & procurement sign-off — owner: procure@clearlinehealth.com — target: 2027-09-22 (internal vendor review meeting)
- Contract signature (DocuSign) — owner: Clearline signatory — target: 2027-09-29
- Provisioning & onboarding (canary) — owner: Marcus Lin (Redwood) — target: 2027-10-04

If you can confirm the 9/22 vendor review slot and legal availability on the 18th, we will finalize the MAP and issue an editable DocuSign-ready SOW for comment.

Attachments: Clearline_MAP_v1.1.xlsx (spreadsheet) | Data_Security_Snapshot.pdf (PDF) | SOW_draft_Clearline.pdf (PDF)

Thanks —
Priya

Priya — looping back internally. Marcus, please start the provisioning checklist on a canary capacity so we can hit 10/04 if Clearline signs by 9/29. Marcus, highlight any items that absolutely require the signed contract (e.g., dedicated VPC keys, customer-managed KMS).

PRIORY ITEMS:

Priya/Team — quick update after vendor review: vendor committee greenlit moving forward pending legal redlines. Procurement confirmed they can issue a PO the week of 2027-09-26 if the SOW + pricing table are final by EOD 2027-09-22.

Signatory availability: I confirmed with our CFO's EA — the earliest signature slot we can practically target is 2027-09-29. That meets the 9/30 runway you proposed. Please send a DocuSign-ready contract/SOW to procure@clearlinehealth.com and cc me; procurement will route to the signatory once PO and legal redlines are cleared.

Action items for Redwood: 
- Priya: upload DocuSign-ready SOW by 2027-09-22 EOD (procurement + legal asked).
- Marcus: stand up canary provisioning prep (placeholder IPs ok) and share pre-provision checklist by 2027-09-23.

We should be set for a 2027-09-29 signature if those timelines are met. I will confirm PO date once procurement finalizes internal steps.

Thanks everyone —
Tom
